findings.summary: Web searches (shadcn base-nova separator issue, mui/base-ui separator bug) found no reported migration bug. Docs confirm Base UI always sets role=separator and aria-orientation; no decorative prop.

notChecked: GitHub issue trackers were reached only through general web search, not queried directly

differences.reference: Radix default decorative=true renders role="none" with no aria-orientation (read from the live reference DOM: 3 separators, all role=none).
differences.branch: Base UI Separator (node_modules/@base-ui/react/separator/Separator.js, v1.9.0) always renders role="separator" and aria-orientation=<orientation>; screen readers would announce a separator where the reference announces nothing. The base-nova file was not applied; difference established from the primitive's source.
differences.how: Inspect [data-slot=separator] in /gallery section #separator: reference role=none, Base UI role=separator.

differences.reference: Accepts decorative (default true) forwarded to Radix.
differences.branch: Base UI has no decorative prop; the base-nova file drops it. Decorative behaviour would need a manual role="none" override.
differences.how: Compare radix-nova vs base-nova separator.json registry files.

notes: Registry files differ (not a no-op). Class names are identical in both files, so look is expected to match; only accessibility and API differ. Screenshots and keyboard checks were not performed; the decision rests on the reference DOM and the Base UI source. The worktree was on main and was fast-forwarded to factory/base-ui to obtain tasks.json.
reasonNotMoved: Base UI's Separator always exposes role="separator" with aria-orientation and has no decorative prop, while the Radix reference (decorative default true) renders role="none", so assistive tech would newly announce every divider in the gallery (source: node_modules/@base-ui/react/separator/Separator.js v1.9.0; docs https://mintlify.wiki/mui/base-ui/components/separator). Retry once Base UI offers decorative semantics, or if a manual role="none" override in the wrapper is approved.
